name: HR tabs follow the requested order and Employee has no leave clutter
Employee edit is a compact modal without the sample checkbox
Calendar matches Design B, circles today and centers the next agenda event
A saved company holiday updates attendance rules and Upcoming Events
Leave tab calculates working days and projects pending and approved leave
Attendance defaults green, preserves exceptions and uses uniform centered squares
Finalized attendance does not change when calendar settings change
Contract outcome requires a reason and termination archives the employee
Private signed contract upload is linked to the employee
HR records and signed files are included in complete archives
Stale calendar edits are rejected without replacing the saved event
Calendar fits desktop and tablet without page overflow
Employee archive reasons and retained history are accessible
Contract outcomes retain the old term, vacation date and renewal history
Supporting uploads open with their contract and clear document classifications
Contract draft saves to its employee and reopens through the document list
Employment Contract starter can be edited and saved as a Company Template
Contract notifications and Upcoming Events link directly to the correct contract
Working schedules save half-days and legend leave consumes half a day
Informational occasions leave attendance unchanged and saved exceptions survive schedule edits
An open stale event form cannot overwrite a refreshed event
An open stale working schedule cannot overwrite refreshed settings
Attendance aligns every date in 28, 29, 30 and 31-day months
Employee table has a single green edge and no stray Print button
Finalized half-day leave balances stay fractional; older saved rows keep their original count
Employee status cannot bypass the archive reason form
A renewed contract cannot be renewed or terminated again through the old record
Outcome form shows only relevant fields and rejects future-effective status changes
Contract and Assessment employee selectors work independently after switching tabs
A contract opened from a reminder keeps its employee selected when returning to Contracts
Signed uploads remain accessible if the editable-document list fails
Pending leave approval recalculates changed working days and validates the recalculated allowance
Finalized payroll and archived employees reject new leave requests
Repeated Save submits create one operation and keep the dialog open until it finishes
All HR tabs and dialogs fit desktop, tablet portrait and short tablet landscape
Future dates are gray, rollover restores status, and saved exceptions stay intact
Attendance fills its desktop module and centers every date over equal compact squares
Agenda begins without a spacer, retains green accents and has no month arrows or today shadow
English news is sourced, pending approval and cannot silently alter schedules
News approval is explicit, persists once, and changed proposals need a new decision
Invalid news dates and unsafe source URLs fail validation
No uncaught errors
